Name: Maru Overhaul
Author: 123frog
Description:
This mod is no longer supported, check out the new version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22075]HERE
[/url]
I've always thought Maru was done dirty with her vanilla appearance. She's a great character, but her hair makes me sad. Here I've given her more 'natural' hair and also changed a few things to fit my personal tastes. I essentially mashed[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6375] Maru's hair and face by Pinzol[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Maru's body by Poltergeister[/url], and made a few edits along the way.

If you want a version of Maru with more vanilla colours please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6375]Pinzol's Maru[/url]. Their mod completely inspired this one and deserves lots of love.

This is made to be used with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Characters-Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿, but I haven't finished the seasonal portraits yet. There's a nose and no nose version in the files. You can choose which one you like best.

I would love to hear any feedback or bugs. I'm still learning and am always looking to improve :)
[b]
[size=3]What I Changed:[/size][/b]
Darker, curly hair
Larger glasses
Outfit colour tweaks
Scrubs for clinic
Hair wrap for sleeping
New wedding and Flower Dance dresses
Hair tied up when working at the clinic and in the summer (to come)
Character sprites in [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Characters-Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] style﻿

[b][size=3]Download instructions[/size][/b]
- Install SMAPI
- Install Content Patcher
- Unzip downloaded file
- Drag the '[CP] Maru' folder into the 'mods' folder
Note: if using with seasonal characters, you have to disable Maru in the config file or this mod won't show up in game

[b]
[/b][size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25655304]Pinzol[/url] is the original portrait and character sprite creator. Mine is mostly just a recolour of their hard work
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] created the sprites for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Characters-Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], as well as the base I used for the scrubs
Both the sleeping outfit and scrubs were inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]
